recent_articles.title: Trinamool MLA arrested, several leaders quit party post - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dilip Mondal**, a Trinamool Congress MLA from Bishnupur, was arrested by **West Bengal police** in Odisha on Wednesday (May 27, 2026) after days of evading arrest. The arrest follows an investigation into alleged threats against **BJP** workers during the West Bengal Assembly elections and a previous complaint filed against him.  The arrest marks the first time a sitting MLA has been apprehended by **West Bengal police**. This comes amidst a wave of arrests targeting local Trinamool Congress workers, including former Minister **Sujit Bose**, for their alleged involvement in corruption and post-poll violence. The situation is further complicated by mass resignations from Trinamool leaders, including senior leader **Kakoli Ghosh Dastidar** and several councillors.  The party's leadership is also facing criticism for the lack of a designated space for the Leader of Opposition, **Sovandeb Chattopadhyay**, in the West Bengal Assembly premises.

recent_articles.title: Govt. absorbed global oil shock, didn’t pass it on to consumers: Hardeep Puri - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Union Petroleum and Natural Gas Minister Hardeep Singh Puri** stated that India maintained stable energy supplies despite a 60-day disruption caused by the closure of the Strait of Hormuz. He attributed this stability to long-term planning and timely policy interventions by the **Narendra Modi government**, which absorbed global shock at the fiscal level instead of passing it on to consumers.  **Mr. Puri** highlighted that India ensured uninterrupted availability of various fuels, while also emphasizing the country's diversification efforts in crude sourcing and LPG imports. Gujarat Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel emphasized the state's role as a growth hub for industries like chemicals, pharmaceuticals, textiles, and tourism.

recent_articles.title: Indiramma housing programme will be accelerated; more powers to Collectors, says Ponguleti - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ponguleti Srinivasa Reddy**, the Revenue and Housing Minister, announced a series of measures to expedite the **Indiramma Housing Scheme**. These include decentralizing powers to District Collectors and appointing special officers for each erstwhile district.  The Minister also directed weekly reviews by Collectors to address local issues and prevent bottlenecks.

recent_articles.title: ED raids a political vendetta, claims Nalapad; Congress leaders question timing - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Enforcement Directorate (ED)** conducted searches at various locations in Bengaluru on Tuesday as part of a cybercrime and cryptocurrency-related money laundering case involving **Srikrishna Ramesh**, also known as Sriki.  **Mohammed Haris Nalapad**, son of Congress MLA N.A. Haris, claimed the action was politically motivated, alleging it aimed to derail his father's ministerial prospects. **The ED has not yet issued a statement regarding the outcome or evidence collected.**  **Congress leaders** have accused the **BJP** of targeting them through investigating agencies, citing similar raids not being conducted on **BJP leaders**. **Siddaramaiah**, the Chief Minister, and other officials expressed concern over the timing of the raids and questioned their relevance.

recent_articles.title: Inventory of jewels in inner chamber of Jagannath Temple in Puri begins after 48 years - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Odisha government**, in collaboration with the **Reserve Bank of India** and temple priests, began a comprehensive inventory of valuables stored in the Bhitara Ratna Bhandar at the Shree Jagannath Temple in Puri. The team documented 20 types of ornaments using 3D mapping and color-coding systems to categorize them by material, with each bag assigned a unique serial number.  The inventory aims to verify the current state of the chamber's valuables against a 1978 record and ensure their safety after concerns were raised by the **Orissa High Court**.

recent_articles.title: CM’s political secretary Naseer Ahmed ‘asked’ to quit - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following allegations of anti-party activities by some Muslim leaders in the Davangere South Assembly bypoll, **Abdul Jabbar**, chairman of the **KPCC Minority Cell** resigned.  His resignation followed a request from **Siddaramaiah’s** political secretary, **Naseer Ahmed**, to step down. Two Muslim leaders and Housing Minister B.Z. Zameer Ahmed Khan are accused of not campaigning for the Congress candidate, Samarth Mallikarjun, potentially impacting the election outcome.

recent_articles.title: Jaishankar to visit UAE as India steps up energy diplomacy in the Gulf - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **S. Jaishankar**, **External Affairs Minister of India**, will visit the United Arab Emirates on April 11 and 12 to strengthen ties with the country and discuss energy security amidst ongoing tensions between the U.S., Israel, and Iran.  This follows a series of outreach efforts by India's government, including visits by **Hardeep Singh Puri**, Minister of Petroleum and Natural Gas, to Qatar and conversations with Bahrain's Commerce and Industry Minister, **Piyush Goyal**. The Indian government is seeking to secure energy supplies while also strengthening ties with Gulf nations.

recent_articles.title: Migratory birds pose huge risk to flights, says wildlife body, rejects greenfield international airport plan in Puri - The Hindu
recent_articles.sentiment_target: greenfield international airport plan in Puri
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Wildlife Institute of India (WII)** has advised against the construction of a greenfield international airport in Puri, citing potential harm to migratory birds and proximity to Chilika Lake, a Ramsar site.  **The Odisha government**, **Airports Authority of India**, and the **Ministry of Civil Aviation** had previously supported the project, which was proposed on 471.401 hectares at Sipasurubali village in Puri.

recent_articles.title: IRCTC launches summer spl Bharat Gaurav trains with four pilgrimage packages - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC)** has launched four new Bharat Gaurav Tourist Trains offering pilgrimage packages from **Hyderabad**. The trains will depart from Secunderabad and cover destinations such as Ayodhya, Kashi, Haridwar, Rishikesh, Tiruvannamalai, Rameswaram, Madurai, Kanyakumari, Thanjavur, Chidambaram, Puri, Konark, Baidyanath Dham, Varanasi, and Prayagraj.  Passengers can book the packages through IRCTC's website or by contacting designated phone numbers.

recent_articles.title: Deve Gowda, HDK, Chalavadi joined hands with BJP for their own political existence, says Chief Minister Siddaramaiah - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister Siddaramaiah** criticized former Prime Minister **H.D. Deve Gowda**, former Chief Minister **H.D. Kumaraswamy**, and Leader of the Opposition in Legislative Council **Chalavadi Narayanaswamy** for joining the BJP, claiming they are only seeking political survival.  He accused them of hypocrisy for criticizing the RSS and **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** while now aligning with the party. **Siddaramaiah** also highlighted the people's support for the state government's guarantee schemes and criticized the BJP for opposing them.
